decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's established dumper line, still has its own page, and shows no sign of trouble, so the firm has invested in it visibly and has no reason to write it off.
The articulated dumper builds on the core offer and keeps a dedicated page, so dropping it would waste a visible investment in a growing market.

The rescue vehicle is far from the core offer and fell from its own page to a mere mention, but development costs are sunk and mining-safety demand is lumpy, so weak results can still be blamed on temporary factors.
A multi-model telescopic loader line with its own page is a substantial and public commitment to the firm's direction, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
The material lift line is close to the core offer and the firm publicly cites a large order as proof of its success, so it will stay.
The firm publicly highlights 1,000 operating hours in 7 months for this mining loader, which shows visible commitment and positive results.
